claude_proposed_widenings.name: ModifySpeedOperation
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The ongoing_effect family exists and is the correct fit for Fly, but OngoingOperation only supports roll_modifier and damage_on_hit. Fly grants a fly speed (60 ft) + hover — a modify_speed operation. The v4 atom 'modify_speed' exists in the taxonomy but has not been added as an OngoingOperation variant.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: For the duration, the target gains a Fly Speed of 60 feet and can hover.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: FallOnEndLifecycleEffect
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The spell specifies a conditional fall-on-end consequence: 'When the spell ends, the target falls if it is still aloft unless it can stop the fall.' The v4 atom 'fall_on_end' exists in the taxonomy but is not yet surfaced in any surface type. This is secondary to the modify_speed widening — the core blocker is the missing operation variant.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: When the spell ends, the target falls if it is still aloft unless it can stop the fall.
